title: 1Password for Students
original_html:
As an active student at York University, you are eligible for a free 1Password for Students account. Please follow the steps below for help with obtaining the required license key and activating your 1Password account.

Step 1:

Navigate to https://mysoftware.apps01.yorku.ca/ and login with your PY credentials. Next, hover over "PERSONAL" in the grey menu bar and click on "Software Order Form".

Step 2:

Verify that your email address under (1) is correct and then (2) select either "1Password for Students (Undergrad)" OR "1Password for Students (Grad)" as appropriate, select any of the OS options as any choice will work, and make sure to add a License Qty of 1. For (3), select "License codes only - no software CD required" and (4)click on "Continue to Next Step" as no payment is required.

Step 3:

Review the details of your order and make sure the information is correct. Next, navigate to https://1password.com/legal/terms-of-service and review the terms before checking the "I agree to these terms and conditions" box. Finally, click on "Confirm Order" to continue.

Step 4:

You should be redirected to the page below informing you that your order has been successfully submitted.

Step 5:

You will receive the (3) emails shown below a few minutes after completing your order. Click on the email with subject line "1Password for students (###) license key & instructions" to obtain the license key required to activate your account.

Step 6:

Go to https://1password.com/promo/ and enter the license key and your York student email address. Next, click “Redeem 1Password Account” and check your email for a link to finish creating your account.
